frozen_operator.name: FOUR_SONS_TYPED_FRAGMENT_REASSEMBLY_LEDGER
frozen_operator.law: A recovery certificate is accepted only when four typed content-addressed fragments are present, hash-valid, type-correct, and together reconstruct the exact monolithic parent-delta certificate.
frozen_operator.storage_rule: Fragment payloads are content-addressed and stored once per run; each transition stores exactly four 32-byte SHA-256 references in fixed typed slots.
frozen_operator.reassembly_rule: Resolve all four references, verify hash and expected type, rebuild ParentRecoveryDelta, reconstruct exact parent, verify parent commitment, and forward-replay to exact child.
frozen_operator.authorization_rule: Fragment ledger can reconstruct/verify recovery data only. It cannot authorize SAT, UNSAT, equivalence, absorption, pruning, or a semantic merge.

frozen_wire_accounting.fragment_store_entry: 1 byte type tag + 4 byte payload length + payload bytes
frozen_wire_accounting.transition_manifest: exactly 4 SHA-256 references = 128 bytes; slot order carries type
frozen_wire_accounting.clause_list_payload: same encoding as parent-delta: 4-byte clause count + each clause as 2-byte literal count + 4 bytes per signed literal
frozen_wire_accounting.comparison_baseline: monolithic recovery_delta_wire_bytes from frozen parent run

gates: parent SON_RETURN_PATH result is reproduced exactly
every transition resolves exactly four typed fragments
every reassembled delta equals the original monolithic delta
every reassembled delta reconstructs the exact immediate parent
every reconstructed parent forward-replays to the exact child
total unique fragment-store bytes plus transition-manifest bytes is strictly less than 6736086 monolithic-delta bytes
zero new residual scans for fragmentation

stop_rule: Any failed gate freezes this implementation as a negative result. No post-hoc change of fragment count, slot semantics, hashing, or accounting.
claim_ceiling: A pass establishes only exact typed content-addressed recovery-certificate reassembly with smaller aggregate stored payload on revealed GT3..GT9.
A pass does not establish lower runtime or RAM on arbitrary CNFs.
A pass does not establish a universal polynomial residual automaton.
